description: Fetches top-ranked traders on Polymarket ranked by overall profit or trading volume across customizable time windows (day, week, month, all). Includes rank, wallet address, username/pseudonym if public, profit PnL, and total trading volume. Information only, not financial advice. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

limit.description: Number of top traders to return (max 100)

sortBy.description: Metric to rank by: profit (default) or volume

window.description: Time window: day, week, month, or all
